Class: Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: 4m/yds

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Special Features: Requires BODY 11+ to be wielded. If wielded by a user with BODY 13+, this weapon deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6), and targets hit must beat a DV15 Athletics Check to not be knocked Prone.

Range: 4m/yds
Pre-installed: Long Handle (effects already included in these stats)
